result:
No crash or fatal errors in the logs. Phase 1 (App shell) is complete.

Summary:
- Added `app/components/Health.vue` and `app/components/Transcribe.vue` as static placeholder screens matching SPEC.md §3.2/§3.3 exactly.
- Updated `app/components/Home.vue` with the title, subtitle, and two navigation buttons per §3.1, using `$navigateTo` from `nativescript-vue`.
- Back navigation relies on the framework's automatic Frame back button (visible in the ActionBar), satisfying "each feature screen provides a way to navigate back to Home."
- `ns build ios` succeeds; verified live on the iOS Simulator via `idb`/`simctl` — navigated Home → Health → back and Home → Transcribe → back, all labels match spec exactly, no crashes in the device log.
